answer: A reputation river only flows one way: each agent payment history is published on-ledger, so a new identity starts with no trust and must earn it through many small, verified trades. A sybil swarm faces a gale of costs: every fake identity must repeat that slow earning process, while an honest agent, like a lone sparrow flying straight, builds one durable record. Attackers pay in time and fees per identity; the economy makes fakes expensive and honesty cheap.
